en: The Buddha spoke this *Sūtra of the Heavenly Lord*:
"Molten copper was cast for the pillars; ivory was used for the rafters; amber for the roof-beams; pearls for the lattice-work;
the constellations for the *quètóu* (crow-head) ornaments; and the sun and moon for the round windows. It may be ten thousand [leagues] in height."
Nineteen thousand years;
above is one small kalpa,
and below is one yojana.
Although this sutra is small, it possesses great majestic power;
it is equal to the Lotus Sutra and equal to the Nirvana Sutra.
It is also like a miscellaneous scripture;
it is like the Eastern Sea,
and may be compared to Mount Tai.
Entering the sea to retrieve treasures,
one may return again with as much as was obtained.
Entering the mountains to gather timber is likewise.
Even those of varying talents and capacities may yet return;
who can transcribe this sutra?
The spiral markings on their palms shall be formed.
Whoever can read this sutra,
a double radiance will arise in their eyes;
whoever can recite this sutra...
Possessing great wisdom throughout kalpas,
Avalokiteśvara fashioned this golden image; by it,
even great sins shall be eliminated.
Minor offenses are extinguished;
when one approaches the mountain of blades,
the mountain of blades crumbles and breaks apart.
If he wishes to go toward the Sword-Tree Hell,
the sword-trees spontaneously break; if he wishes to go toward the Charcoal Pit Hell, [the pit spontaneously cools].
The charcoal in the brazier extinguished itself;
as he wished to go toward the cauldron of boiling water,
the cauldron of boiling water cooled itself.
The spiritual sounds resounded clearly and brightly;
in the center of the lecture hall, the ground was made of lapis lazuli and adorned with silver.
Previously he ascended the golden throne, and later he served as a king; with his own hands he held the Golden Sutra.
Upon arriving, the Buddha spoke these words:
"Remember the Buddha as you remember food."
Reciting the Buddha's name as one would cherish one's own life;
reciting it five times a day eliminates the sins of fifteen million kalpas.
All were liberated and attained the Buddha-way.
The *Foshuotiangongjing* (Sutra Spoken by the Buddha on the Heavenly Lord), one fascicle.
